fit.DroneStats.ActiveTypeIDs: unique typeIDs with at least one drone launched
fit.EFTLine.Charge: Charge is the name after the first comma ("Module, Charge"); "" if none.
fit.EFTLine.Mutated: Mutated is true when the line carried the [MUTATED] suffix: the module's real attributes are rolled by the mutaplasmid and differ from the base item's.
fit.EFTLine.Name: Name is the item as written, without quantity, charge, state marker or the [MUTATED] suffix: a mutated module is looked up by its base item.
fit.EFTLine.Qty: Qty is the trailing "xN" (drone and ammo stacks); 1 when absent.
fit.EFTLine.Section: Section is the slot group the line's position suggests (blank-line separated sections: "high", "mid", "low", "rig", "subsystem").
fit.FitModule.ChargeID: resolved typeID of the charge (0 if none/unresolved)
fit.FitStats.Estimated: Estimated is true when one or more values are approximations.
fit.FitStats.Unmodelled: Unmodelled lists modules/effects the engine did not model.
fit.FreqMod.Count: fits containing this module in the slot
fit.RawInput.SDESlots: SDESlots: the SDE supplies slots, groups and categories for the resolved lines. False in the ESI-only mode: every line then takes its ParserSlot, draws its raw CPU / PG and no group limit is checked.
fit.RawLine.Charge: Charge is the charge loaded in the module ("Module, Charge") and ChargeID its resolved type (0 when none or unresolved). Only the Alpha check reads them.
fit.RawLine.Mutated: Mutated: the line was a mutated (abyssal) module. TypeID is its base item, so its CPU / PG / slot are the base item's, not the rolled ones.
fit.RawLine.ParserSlot: ParserSlot is the slot group the line's position in the block suggests (blank line separated sections: "high", "mid", "low", "rig", "subsystem"). It is only used for a name that resolves to no type, or when the SDE has no slot data.
fit.RawLine.State: State is the module's state marker: "" (online), "offline" or "overheat". An offline module is still charged its CPU / PG but does not boost the hull's output (an offline RCU adds no powergrid).
fit.RawLine.TypeID: TypeID is the resolved type, or 0 when the name resolved to nothing.
fit.RawOptions.Alpha: Alpha + Legality: the skill-based Alpha check (Legality.IsAlphaLegalType) of every slot module and of the hull — the same rule Validate applies. Without a Legality the Alpha check is skipped.
fit.Report.Slots: Slots is the modules in each slot group against the slots the hull has.
fit.Report.Unresolved: Unresolved are the names that resolved to no type (CheckRaw only), in the order written. They take a slot but are not counted in CPUUsed / PGUsed.
fit.StatsOpts.ActiveDroneTypeIDs: ActiveDroneTypeIDs, when non-nil, is the priority list of drone typeIDs the user has launched. The engine launches them in order within bandwidth + the max-in-space cap; the rest stay in the bay (no DPS). nil → auto (fit order).
fit.Violation.Capacity: Load / Capacity: the draw against the hull's output of a CodeCPUOver / CodePGOver.
fit.Violation.Consumers: Consumers are the heaviest modules of a CodeCPUOver / CodePGOver, heaviest first.
fit.Violation.Count: Count / Limit: the modules found against the allowance (slots of the group, or the group's maxGroupFitted).
fit.Violation.Limit: Count / Limit: the modules found against the allowance (slots of the group, or the group's maxGroupFitted).
fit.Violation.Load: Load / Capacity: the draw against the hull's output of a CodeCPUOver / CodePGOver.
fit.Violation.Names: Names are the modules the violation is about.
fit.Violation.Slot: Slot is the slot group of a CodeSlotOverflow: "hi", "mid", "low", "rig" or "subsystem".
rag.Attribution.Author: Author is the person behind the fit when the corpus knows one.
rag.Attribution.Credit: Credit is who must be credited next to the text ("EVE University" for wiki text).
rag.Attribution.License: License is the short statement of the terms the data is used under.
rag.Attribution.LicenseURL: LicenseURL links the licence text, where there is one.
rag.Attribution.Source: Source is the corpus source (workbench, abysstracker, ...) or, for wiki text, the page title.
rag.Attribution.SourceURL: SourceURL is the link to the original page or fit. Never empty for a hit served by a fit path: the ingest writers refuse a fit without one.
rag.FitHit.Attribution: Attribution is the credit the hit must carry wherever it is shown.
rag.FitHit.FitName: FitName is the label list_fits prints per row: the fit_name, or the name fitDisplayName derives for a point that has none. Never empty, never a doc_kind.
rag.FitQuery.Source: explicit source override; empty → default MatchAny set
rag.FitScrollResult.DroppedFilters: filters dropped during relaxation, in insertion order
rag.FitSearchHit.Attribution: Attribution is the credit the fit must carry wherever it is shown.
rag.FitSearchQuery.Abyss: Abyss pins fit_tags=abyss as an essential condition (never relaxed): an abyss request whose tier / filament facets had to be dropped must still be answered with abyss fits, not with whatever else the corpus holds.
rag.FitSearchQuery.Accept: Accept, when set, drops every candidate it rejects BEFORE the pool is counted (ShipCounts) and ranked, on every pass. It is for rules the payload cannot express, such as Alpha legality by required skills. nil keeps every candidate.
rag.FitSearchQuery.Archetype: archetypeMarkers key (kite/brawl); "" = no archetype ranking/sufficiency requirement
rag.FitSearchQuery.PerShip: PerShip > 0 keeps at most that many hits per ship_name in the returned page (the best-ranked ones), so a class browse sees many hulls instead of one hull's top fits; FitSearchResult.ShipCounts still counts every matching fit.
rag.FitSearchQuery.Q: free-text; empty → scroll, non-empty → vector search
rag.FitSearchQuery.ShipNames: ShipNames restricts the search to any of these ship_names (a hull class such as "Black Ops"); ignored when ShipName is set. Like ShipName it is never relaxed.
rag.FitSearchQuery.Source: explicit source; empty → default MatchAny set
rag.FitSearchQuery.TankType: tankTypeMarkers key (armor/shield/passive-shield/active-shield); "" = no tank-type ranking/sufficiency requirement
rag.FitSearchQuery.Tested: true → prefer/require player-tested fits (ranking behavior lands separately)
rag.FitSearchQuery.WeaponFamily: weaponFamilyMarkers key (railgun/blaster/artillery/autocannon/laser/missile); "" = no weapon-family ranking/sufficiency requirement
rag.FitSearchResult.Limit: Limit is the page size actually applied (the request's, clamped to FitPageMax).
rag.FitSearchResult.Note: Note says so when the request asked for more than FitPageMax; omitted otherwise.
rag.FitSearchResult.ShipCounts: ShipCounts is the number of fits per ship_name in the candidate pool of the pass that produced Hits, before the page is trimmed. Set only when the query asked for PerShip grouping; nil otherwise.
rag.HullAffinity.Bonus: Bonus is the weapon systems the hull's role/skill bonuses name (see WeaponSystemsFromTraits); empty when the hull is unknown or carries no weapon bonus.
rag.HullAffinity.Launchers: Launchers is true when the hull has launcher hardpoints (dogma 101 > 0). Like Racial it is read only for a drone-only hull: missile launchers there are hull-hardpoint filler, in doctrine whatever the hull's race.
rag.HullAffinity.Racial: Racial is the hull race's weapon doctrine (see RacialSystems). It is read only for a drone-only hull (isDroneHull), whose bonuses name no weapon system: there it separates racial filler (lasers on an Amarr hull) from an off-race loadout. Empty when the race is unknown or fields no doctrine.
rag.ListFitQuery.Limit: bounded to [1,FitPageMax] by ScrollListFits; default FitPageMax
rag.ListFitQuery.Source: explicit source; empty → default MatchAny list
rag.ListFitQuery.Tag: matches any element in fit_tags payload list
rag.ListFitScrollResult.Clamped: Clamped reports that the requested limit exceeded FitPageMax and was cut to it.
rag.ListFitScrollResult.Points: up to Limit points with payload
rag.ListFitScrollResult.Total: exact Qdrant count matching the filter
sde.JumpRangeFilter.Origin: Origin is the solarSystemID the jump starts in; it is never part of the result.
sde.JumpRangeFilter.RangeLY: RangeLY is the jump range in light-years.
sde.JumpRangeFilter.Ship: Ship is the hull (or the Ansiblex) whose valid jump targets are kept.
sde.JumpRouteOptions.Avoid: systems no hop ends in (the stops are exempt)
sde.JumpRouteOptions.AvoidRegions: regions no hop ends in (the stops are exempt)
sde.JumpRouteOptions.PreferStations: among the routes with the fewest jumps, fewest hops ending without an NPC station
sde.JumpShip.Ansiblex: fixed range, no skills, no ship fuel, ends only in player-sovereign nullsec
sde.JumpShip.BaseFuelPerLY: jumpDriveConsumptionAmount before skills; 0 for the Ansiblex
sde.JumpShip.CanBridge: a jump portal generator fits the hull's group
sde.JumpShip.CanConduit: the hull or its portal generator enables conduit jumps
sde.JumpShip.Group: SDE group name: "Jump Freighter", "Upwell Jump Bridge"
sde.JumpShip.JumpFreighterBonus: eliteBonusJumpFreighter2 per Jump Freighters level (-10); 0 if none
sde.JumpShip.Name: SDE type name: "Rhea", "Ansiblex Jump Bridge"
sde.ModuleHit.CanLoadCharge: true if the module accepts a charge (ammo)
sde.ModuleHit.CanOverheat: true if the module has an overload effect
sde.NearFilter.MaxJumps: MaxJumps keeps systems at most this many jumps away; 0 = no radius.
sde.NearFilter.Origin: Origin is the solarSystemID the jumps are counted from.
sde.NearFilter.PreferHighSec: PreferHighSec counts jumps through highsec where a highsec route exists, else through any space.
sde.RouteOptions.Avoid: systems never entered; the origin and destination are exempt
sde.RouteOptions.PreferHighSec: first try highsec only (security >= 0.45, the cut GetJumpsPath uses)
sde.SkillTraining.Primary: Primary is the attribute id of the primary training attribute (164 charisma, 165 intelligence, 166 memory, 167 perception, 168 willpower; dogma 180).
sde.SkillTraining.Secondary: Secondary is the attribute id of the secondary training attribute (dogma 181).
sde.SystemFacts.Belts: Belts is the number of asteroid belts.
sde.SystemFacts.Faction: Faction is the name of FactionID ("" = none).
sde.SystemFacts.FactionID: FactionID is the system's own factionID, else its constellation's, else its region's (0 = none).
sde.SystemFacts.Moons: Moons is the number of moons.
sde.SystemFacts.NPCStations: NPCStations is the number of NPC stations.
sde.SystemFacts.Name: Name is the canonical system name.
sde.SystemFacts.Neighbours: Neighbours are the stargate destinations, sorted by name.
sde.SystemFacts.Planets: Planets is the number of planets.
sde.SystemFacts.PlanetsByType: PlanetsByType counts planets per type, keyed by the type name without the "Planet (" prefix.
sde.SystemFacts.Security: Security is the raw true security status; use DisplaySecurity for the value the game shows.
sde.SystemFacts.Stargates: Stargates is the number of stargates.
sde.SystemFacts.StationServices: StationServices is the sorted union of the services of the system's NPC stations.
sde.SystemFacts.WormholeClass: WormholeClass is the class of the system, else of its constellation, else of its region (0 = none).
sde.SystemFacts.WormholeEffect: WormholeEffect is the name of the system's secondary sun ("" = none).
sde.SystemFilter.ConstellationID: ConstellationID keeps one constellation's systems; 0 = any.
sde.SystemFilter.FactionID: FactionID keeps systems of one faction (SystemFacts.FactionID); 0 = any.
sde.SystemFilter.HasNPCStation: HasNPCStation keeps systems with (true) or without (false) NPC stations; nil = any.
sde.SystemFilter.JumpRange: JumpRange keeps the systems a ship can jump to from an origin and ranks them by light-years; nil = no jump filter.
sde.SystemFilter.MinBelts: MinBelts keeps systems with at least this many asteroid belts.
sde.SystemFilter.Near: Near ranks by jumps from an origin and leaves out systems without a gate route; nil = no ranking.
sde.SystemFilter.OnlyIDs: OnlyIDs restricts the result to these systems; nil = no restriction.
sde.SystemFilter.PlanetTypes: PlanetTypes are canonical names; a system must have at least one planet of each.
sde.SystemFilter.RegionID: RegionID keeps one region's systems; 0 = any.
sde.SystemFilter.SecMax: SecMax keeps systems whose displayed security (DisplaySecurity) is at most this; nil = any.
sde.SystemFilter.SecMin: SecMin keeps systems whose displayed security (DisplaySecurity) is at least this; nil = any.
sde.SystemFilter.Sort: Sort is "jumps", "security", "name" or "ly" ("" = ly with JumpRange, else jumps with Near, else name; an unknown value sorts by name).
sde.SystemFilter.StationServices: StationServices are canonical service names; a system must offer all of them.
sde.SystemFilter.WormholeClass: WormholeClass keeps systems of one wormhole class; 0 = any.
sde.SystemMatch.HighsecRoute: HighsecRoute is true only when Near.PreferHighSec was set and a highsec-only route exists to the system; it is false otherwise, including for an all-highsec route found without PreferHighSec.
sde.SystemMatch.Jumps: Jumps is the gate distance from Near.Origin, -1 without Near.
sde.SystemMatch.LY: LY is the distance in light-years from JumpRange.Origin, -1 without JumpRange.
sde.TypeFacts.BasePrice: BasePrice is nil when invTypes leaves it empty.
sde.TypeFacts.MarketGroupPath: MarketGroupPath lists the market group names, root first; nil without a market group.
sde.TypeFacts.MetaGroupID: MetaGroupID is 0 when invMetaTypes has no row for the type; there is no "Tech I" fallback.
sde.TypeFacts.MetaLevel: MetaLevel and TechLevel are nil when invTypes leaves them empty.
sde.TypeFacts.PackagedVolumeM3: PackagedVolumeM3 is nil when invTypes leaves it empty.
sde.TypeFacts.PortionSize: PortionSize is 1 when invTypes leaves it empty.
tools.ActivityList.Systems: Systems holds one row per resolved system, in request order, duplicates collapsed.
tools.ActivityList.Unresolved: Unresolved lists requested names that are not solar systems.
tools.AveragePrice.AverageISK: AverageISK is EVE's average price in ISK, null when the item has none.
tools.AveragePrice.Name: Name is the item name as the SDE spells it.
tools.AveragePrice.TypeID: TypeID is the item's type ID.
tools.AveragePrices.AsOf: AsOf is the date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) of the price list the numbers come from; null when no price list was read (every item was unknown).
tools.AveragePrices.Prices: Prices has one row per distinct item, in the order first asked.
tools.AveragePrices.Unresolved: Unresolved lists names that are not items, and type IDs that are not in the SDE or not whole numbers (as "type_id N"); names are listed trimmed.
tools.CapCard.ChargeFed: ChargeFed is true when an ancillary rep runs on charges, not on the capacitor, which makes the capacitor figures meaningless.
tools.CapCard.Summary: Summary is "stable" or "lasts 442s", empty when there is nothing trustworthy to say (no capacitor data, or reps that run on charges).
tools.ClassCounts.Highsec: Highsec counts the highsec systems entered, the origin excluded.
tools.ClassCounts.Lowsec: Lowsec counts the lowsec systems entered.
tools.ClassCounts.Nullsec: Nullsec counts the nullsec systems entered.
tools.Client.ESI: ESI is the shared ESI client. Nil means "build one from HTTP on first use", so a Client literal with only HTTP and Throttle still works.
tools.Client.UserAgent: UserAgent is the project User-Agent sent to Janice, Frankfurter, zKillboard, br.evetools.org and WarBeacon (esi.ProjectUserAgent). Empty means "build it from the environment on use", so a Client literal with only HTTP and Throttle works.
tools.CommunityFit.EFT: EFT is the fit text as stored (the markdown header some sources prepend included).
tools.CommunityFits.Relaxed: Relaxed is true when tag filters were dropped to find these (the text says which).
tools.Deps.JaniceAPIKey: JaniceAPIKey, when set, makes appraise_items a Janice appraisal; empty means the estimate from ESI's average prices. Set from config; a public surface replaces it with the caller's own key (ForPublic).
tools.Deps.Legality: Legality is the one Alpha-clone legality checker (skill allowlist + meta tier) behind validate_fitting and the fit controller, built once where the Deps are (bootstrap). nil → AlphaLegality builds one lazily, once (tests, struct literals); nil there too when the allowlist cannot be loaded.
tools.Deps.Public: Public marks answers that go to a reader other than the chat brain (the public REST and MCP surfaces, a bot post): tool texts leave out the chat loop's instructions and get_ship_bonuses answers the bonus section only. Typed data does not change. The zero value is the chat brain's text, which the golden tests pin.
tools.Deps.Retriever: nil (SDE-only mode) → get_fits / list_fits say the corpus is not configured
tools.Deps.Stats: Stats is the one dogma engine behind compute_fit_stats and the validate_fitting stat card, built once over SDE where the Deps are (bootstrap) so every call reuses its warm SDE memo (a cold engine reads ~2x slower). nil → StatsEngine builds one lazily, once (tests, struct literals).
tools.FitCell.CanLoadCharge: true if the module accepts a charge (ammo)
tools.FitCell.CanOverheat: true if the module has an overload effect
tools.FitDetail.Unresolved: Unresolved are the module names the SDE could not resolve, once each in EFT order. They are missing from Slots and not counted in Resources. Never null.
tools.FitDetail.Valid: Valid is true when every module resolved and the fit has no Hard violation (slot overflow, group limit, CPU / PG beyond the 5 % implant allowance, a name that is not a module). When false the Resources totals are not the totals of a legal fit — with Unresolved set they are the totals of the resolved part only — and a consumer should show "—" rather than present them as the fit's numbers.
tools.FitDetail.Violations: Violations are the Hard rule failures other than unresolved names; omitted when none.
tools.FitStatCard.Basis: Basis is "all-V", or "all-V, default ammo" when the engine loaded ammo.
tools.FitStatCard.DPS: DPS includes the drones; WeaponDPS and DroneDPS split it.
tools.FitStatCard.Load: Load is the CPU / PG line, present on compute_fit_stats and nil inside a FitValidation (which carries them itself).
tools.FitStatCard.NoAmmo: NoAmmo names weapons that ended up with no charge (counted as 0 DPS).
tools.FitStatCard.PropOn: PropOn is true when an online afterburner / MWD is part of SpeedMS.
tools.FitStatCard.UnresolvedCharges: UnresolvedCharges are charge names written on the EFT that did not resolve.
tools.FitStatCard.UnresolvedModules: UnresolvedModules are module names the engine could not resolve (not counted).
tools.FitValidation.AlphaUnchecked: AlphaUnchecked is true when alpha=true was requested but the Alpha skill caps were unavailable (ESI-only mode), so clone legality was not checked. Omitted otherwise.
tools.FitValidation.CPU: CPU and PG are the skill-discounted loads against the hull's output with the fitting modifiers applied.
tools.FitValidation.DataSource: DataSource is where names and dogma came from: "SDE" (ESI as fallback) or "ESI".
tools.FitValidation.Stats: Stats is the stat card the text appends for a valid fit validated at the model's request (eft_text); nil otherwise. Its Load is nil: CPU and PG are above.
tools.FitValidation.UnresolvedModules: UnresolvedModules are module names found in neither the SDE nor ESI (not counted).
tools.FitValidation.Violations: Violations are the lines under "VIOLATIONS:" in the text, without the bullet.
tools.FitValidation.Warnings: Warnings are the lines under "WARNINGS" in the text, without the bullet: a CPU or powergrid overage of at most 5 %, which a 5 % output implant closes. The fit is still Valid. Omitted when none.
tools.HistoryBucket.AverageISK: AverageISK is the daily average price weighted by volume (the plain mean when no volume traded).
tools.HistoryBucket.End: End is the last day of the bucket (YYYY-MM-DD); equal to Start for a day.
tools.HistoryBucket.HighestISK: HighestISK is the highest price of any day in the bucket.
tools.HistoryBucket.LowestISK: LowestISK is the lowest price of any day in the bucket.
tools.HistoryBucket.OrderCount: OrderCount is the number of orders, summed over the days of the bucket.
tools.HistoryBucket.Start: Start is the first day of the bucket (YYYY-MM-DD).
tools.HistoryBucket.Volume: Volume is the units traded in the bucket.
tools.HistorySummary.AverageISK: AverageISK is the average price over the window, weighted by volume.
tools.HistorySummary.ChangePct: ChangePct is the change of the average price from the first to the last bucket in percent, null when there is only one bucket or the first bucket's average is 0.
tools.HistorySummary.HighestISK: HighestISK is the highest price in the window.
tools.HistorySummary.LowestISK: LowestISK is the lowest price in the window.
tools.HistorySummary.Volume: Volume is the units traded in the window.
tools.IceBelt.Belts: Belts are the wiki belt pages that list the system.
tools.IceBelt.IceTypes: IceTypes are the ice types found in the system.
tools.IceBelt.SourceURLs: SourceURLs are the wiki pages the entry comes from.
tools.ItemFacts.AlphaUsable: AlphaUsable says whether an Alpha clone can use the item (every skill it needs is within the Alpha caps); null when the Alpha list is unavailable and for NPC types.
tools.ItemFacts.BasePrice: BasePrice is the SDE base price in ISK, not a market price; null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.ItemFacts.CapacityM3: CapacityM3 is the cargo or hold capacity in m³.
tools.ItemFacts.CategoryID: CategoryID and Category are the group's category ("Module", "Ship").
tools.ItemFacts.GroupID: GroupID and Group are the item's group ("Damage Control").
tools.ItemFacts.MarketGroupPath: MarketGroupPath names the market groups from the root down; [] when the item has no market group.
tools.ItemFacts.MassKg: MassKg is the mass in kg.
tools.ItemFacts.MetaGroup: MetaGroup is the meta group ("Tech II", "Faction"); null when the SDE has none for the item.
tools.ItemFacts.MetaLevel: MetaLevel is the SDE meta level (0 for Tech I); null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.ItemFacts.Name: Name is the SDE's spelling of the name.
tools.ItemFacts.PackagedVolumeM3: PackagedVolumeM3 is the volume once packaged; null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.ItemFacts.PortionSize: PortionSize is how many units one reprocessing or production portion covers (1 when the SDE leaves it empty).
tools.ItemFacts.Published: Published is whether the item is in the live game.
tools.ItemFacts.Query: Query is the name as the request spelled it (trimmed).
tools.ItemFacts.TechLevel: TechLevel is 1, 2 or 3; null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.ItemFacts.TypeID: TypeID is the item's type id.
tools.ItemFacts.VolumeM3: VolumeM3 is the volume in m³; for a ship, the assembled volume.
tools.ItemList.Items: Items has one row per distinct resolved name (two spellings of one item collapse to the first).
tools.ItemList.Unresolved: Unresolved lists the names that match no item, each with up to three close matches.
tools.ItemSkills.Chain: Chain lists the skills those need in turn, highest level first; direct skills are left out.
tools.ItemSkills.Direct: Direct lists the skills the item itself requires (a build plan: the blueprint's skills).
tools.ItemSkills.Name: Name is the SDE's spelling of the item name.
tools.ItemSkills.Totals: Totals sums Direct and Chain; null without training_time.
tools.ItemSkills.TypeID: TypeID is the item's type id.
tools.JumpDistance.Class: Class is the text's band: "highsec", "lowsec" or "nullsec".
tools.JumpDistance.HighsecRoute: HighsecRoute is true when Jumps counts a highsec-only route (prefer_high_sec and one exists).
tools.JumpDistance.Jumps: Jumps is the gate-jump count from the origin (0 for the origin itself).
tools.JumpDistance.Sec: Sec is the security exactly as the text prints it ("+0.9").
tools.JumpDistance.Security: Security is the true security status (the text prints it rounded).
tools.JumpDistance.System: System is the system name as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpDistance.SystemID: SystemID is the solar system ID.
tools.JumpDistances.Avoid: Avoid lists the systems no route passes through, origin excluded (a listed target still gets its own count, but no route passes through it).
tools.JumpDistances.Distances: Distances is sorted by Jumps, then System: the order of the text lines.
tools.JumpDistances.Origin: Origin is the origin system as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpDistances.OriginID: OriginID is the origin's solar system ID.
tools.JumpDistances.Unreachable: Unreachable lists requested systems with no gate route (wormhole space, for one) from the origin, including those cut off by Avoid.
tools.JumpDistances.Unresolved: Unresolved lists requested names that are not solar systems.
tools.JumpHopLive.AllianceID: AllianceID is the holding alliance's ID; null when no alliance holds the system.
tools.JumpHopLive.FactionID: FactionID is the holding faction's ID; null when no faction holds the system.
tools.JumpHopLive.Jumps: Jumps is the number of ship jumps through the system in the last hour.
tools.JumpHopLive.NPCKills: NPCKills is the number of NPC ships destroyed in the system in the last hour.
tools.JumpHopLive.PodKills: PodKills is the number of pods destroyed in the system in the last hour.
tools.JumpHopLive.ShipKills: ShipKills is the number of ships destroyed in the system in the last hour.
tools.JumpHopLive.Sovereignty: Sovereignty is the holder: the alliance name, "alliance <id>" when ESI gave no name, the faction name, or "none".
tools.JumpRangeEcho.JumpDriveCalibration: JumpDriveCalibration is the Jump Drive Calibration level behind RangeLY; null for the Ansiblex, which no skill affects.
tools.JumpRangeEcho.Origin: Origin is the origin system as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpRangeEcho.RangeLY: RangeLY is the jump range in light-years that the filter used.
tools.JumpRangeEcho.Ship: Ship is the hull (or "Ansiblex Jump Bridge") as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpRoute.Avoid: Avoid lists the systems no hop ends in, as the SDE spells them, in request order.
tools.JumpRoute.AvoidIncursions: AvoidIncursions is the request flag: no hop ends in a system with an active incursion (read live from ESI).
tools.JumpRoute.AvoidRegions: AvoidRegions lists the regions no hop ends in, as the SDE spells them, in request order.
tools.JumpRoute.CanBridge: CanBridge is true when the hull can open a jump portal for other ships over the same hops.
tools.JumpRoute.CanConduit: CanConduit is true when the hull can conduit jump with passengers over the same hops.
tools.JumpRoute.Destination: Destination is the last stop as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpRoute.DestinationID: DestinationID is the destination's solar system ID.
tools.JumpRoute.FuelPerLY: FuelPerLY is the fuel burned per light-year at these skills, before Jump Drive Economizers; null for the Ansiblex.
tools.JumpRoute.FuelType: FuelType is the isotope the hull burns; null for the Ansiblex.
tools.JumpRoute.FuelVolumeM3: FuelVolumeM3 is the volume of TotalFuel in cubic metres, to 1 decimal; null for the Ansiblex.
tools.JumpRoute.Hops: Hops are hops 1..n in order; the origin is not a hop.
tools.JumpRoute.IncursionSystems: IncursionSystems lists how many systems ESI reports as infested when avoid_incursions read the incursions; 0 when nothing was read (no flag, or a same-system answer).
tools.JumpRoute.Jumps: Jumps is the number of hops (0 when origin and destination are the same system).
tools.JumpRoute.LiveInfo: LiveInfo is the request flag: each hop carries live sovereignty and activity.
tools.JumpRoute.LiveUnavailable: LiveUnavailable is the answer text of the ESI read that failed when live_info could not be added; null otherwise.
tools.JumpRoute.Origin: Origin is the start system as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpRoute.OriginID: OriginID is the start system's solar system ID.
tools.JumpRoute.PreferStations: PreferStations is the request flag: among the routes with the fewest jumps, fewest hops ending in a system without an NPC station.
tools.JumpRoute.RangeLY: RangeLY is the range of one jump in light-years.
tools.JumpRoute.Ship: Ship is the hull (or "Ansiblex Jump Bridge") as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpRoute.ShipGroup: ShipGroup is the SDE group of the hull, e.g. "Jump Freighter" or "Upwell Jump Bridge".
tools.JumpRoute.Skills: Skills are the skill levels the numbers assume; null for the Ansiblex, which no skill affects.
tools.JumpRoute.TotalFuel: TotalFuel is the summed fuel of the hops, each rounded to a whole unit; null for the Ansiblex.
tools.JumpRoute.TotalLY: TotalLY is the summed hop length in light-years, to 3 decimals.
tools.JumpRoute.Waypoints: Waypoints are the requested waypoints as the SDE spells them, in order.
tools.JumpRouteHop.Class: Class is "lowsec" or "nullsec" (a hop never ends in highsec).
tools.JumpRouteHop.Fuel: Fuel is the fuel of the hop, a whole number of units; null for the Ansiblex.
tools.JumpRouteHop.GateJumps: GateJumps is the stargate jumps between the same two systems; null when no gate route connects them.
tools.JumpRouteHop.LY: LY is the length of the hop in light-years, to 3 decimals.
tools.JumpRouteHop.Live: Live is the hop system's live ESI profile; null unless live_info was set and ESI answered.
tools.JumpRouteHop.N: N is the hop number, from 1.
tools.JumpRouteHop.NPCStations: NPCStations is the number of NPC stations in the system.
tools.JumpRouteHop.Sec: Sec is the displayed security as printed in the text, e.g. "+0.4".
tools.JumpRouteHop.Security: Security is the true security status.
tools.JumpRouteHop.System: System is the system the hop ends in, as the SDE spells it.
tools.JumpRouteHop.SystemID: SystemID is that system's solar system ID.
tools.JumpRouteHop.Waypoint: Waypoint is true when the hop ends at a requested waypoint.
tools.JumpSkillLevels.JumpDriveCalibrati: JumpDriveCalibration is the Jump Drive Calibration level, which lengthens the range.
tools.JumpSkillLevels.JumpFreighters: JumpFreighters is the Jump Freighters level; null unless the hull is a jump freighter.
tools.JumpSkillLevels.JumpFuelConservati: JumpFuelConservation is the Jump Fuel Conservation level, which cuts the fuel use.
tools.MarketHistory.Bucket: Bucket is the bucket size: "day" or "week".
tools.MarketHistory.Buckets: Buckets are the rows, oldest first. Days on which nothing traded have no row.
tools.MarketHistory.Days: Days is the length of the window in calendar days, ending at the newest day ESI has.
tools.MarketHistory.Hub: Hub is the hub key the request named ("jita", "amarr", "dodixie", "rens", "hek"); "" when a region or the default was used, and for PLEX.
tools.MarketHistory.Name: Name is the item name as the SDE spells it.
tools.MarketHistory.RegionID: RegionID is the region the history is from (the global PLEX market for PLEX).
tools.MarketHistory.TypeID: TypeID is the item's type ID.
tools.MarketHistory.WindowEnd: WindowEnd is the last day of the window, the newest day ESI has (YYYY-MM-DD); not today.
tools.MarketPrice.BestBuyISK: BestBuyISK is the highest buy price, null when there is no buy order.
tools.MarketPrice.BestSellISK: BestSellISK is the lowest sell price, null when there is no sell order.
tools.MarketPrice.Hub: Hub is the hub key the request named ("jita", "amarr", "dodixie", "rens", "hek"); "" for the region-wide default.
tools.MarketPrice.Market: Market names what the numbers cover: "The Forge / Jita", "Global PLEX market" or a hub's station name.
tools.PublicESIOptions.FailFast: FailFast makes a needed rate-limit wait an error (esi.ErrBackedOff) instead of a sleep.
tools.PublicESIOptions.GuardPercent: GuardPercent is esi.Config.GuardPercent: the share of each group's tokens kept unspent.
tools.PublicESIOptions.Observer: Observer receives one esi.CallEvent per cache hit, request sent and back-off.
tools.Result.Attribution: Attribution names the upstreams behind the result; see Attribution.
tools.Result.Data: Data is a pointer to the tool's typed result struct (TypeInfo, MarketPrice, ShipStats, FitValidation, FitStatCard), built from the same values as Text. It is nil for a tool that has no typed result yet, and for a call that ended in a text-only answer (an unknown id, a parse failure): Text then says why.
tools.Result.Text: Text is exactly what ExecuteTool returns: the string the brain and the guards parse. It never changes with the typed results.
tools.Result.Tool: Tool is the tool name as called.
tools.Result.Version: Version is the build version of this binary (version).
tools.Route.Avoid: Avoid lists the systems the route never enters, as the SDE spells them; the origin, destination and via stops are never avoided, so they are not listed.
tools.Route.CountsByClass: CountsByClass counts the systems the route enters, by security band.
tools.Route.Detail: Detail is the requested output: "route" (the hop list) or "summary" (one line).
tools.Route.From: From is the origin: the SDE's canonical spelling in summary mode, as typed in route mode.
tools.Route.HighsecOnlyJumps: HighsecOnlyJumps is the jump count of a highsec-only route with the same via and avoid; null when it was not computed (prefer_high_sec is true) or none exists.
tools.Route.HopsOmitted: HopsOmitted is how many systems at the end of the route Systems leaves out because a route lists at most 100 jumps; 0 when all are listed (Jumps counts the whole route).
tools.Route.Jumps: Jumps is the full jump count of the route, also when systems is capped (see hops_omitted).
tools.Route.LowestSecurityHop: LowestSecurityHop is the least secure system the route enters (the origin does not count); null for a 0-jump route.
tools.Route.PreferHighSec: PreferHighSec is the request flag; HighsecSatisfied is false when no pure-highsec route exists and the path is the any-sec fallback (the text says so).
tools.Route.Systems: Systems lists the stops, origin first: all of them for a route of up to 100 jumps, the first 101 stops (100 jumps) for a longer one; it is [] when Detail is "summary".
tools.Route.To: To is the destination: the SDE's canonical spelling in summary mode, as typed in route mode.
tools.Route.Via: Via lists the systems the route passes through, in order, as the SDE spells them.
tools.RouteSystem.Class: Class is the text's band: "highsec", "lowsec" or "nullsec".
tools.RouteSystem.Region: Region is the region name from the SDE, "" when the SDE has none.
tools.RouteSystem.Sec: Sec is the security exactly as the text prints it ("+0.9", "-0.3").
tools.ShipStats.Attributes: Attributes is sorted by Name, the order of the text lines.
tools.SkillLevel.Level: Level is the level needed, 1 to 5.
tools.SkillLevel.Name: Name is the skill's name.
tools.SkillLevel.Rank: Rank is the skill's training time multiplier; 0 when the SDE has none.
tools.SkillLevel.SP: SP is the skill points from zero to Level; null without training_time.
tools.SkillLevel.SkillID: SkillID is the skill's type id.
tools.SkillLevel.TrainingSeconds: TrainingSeconds is the time from zero to Level; null without training_time.
tools.SkillPlan.Attributes: Attributes holds the training attributes behind the times; null without training_time.
tools.SkillPlan.Combined: Combined is the union of the skills of all items (each at its highest level); null for one item or without training_time.
tools.SkillPlan.Items: Items has one row per distinct resolved item, in request order.
tools.SkillPlan.Purpose: Purpose is "fly" (the skills to use the item) or "build" (the blueprint's manufacturing skills).
tools.SkillPlan.Unresolved: Unresolved lists the requested names that match no item.
tools.SkillTotals.SP: SP is the skill points to train all of them from zero.
tools.SkillTotals.Skills: Skills is how many distinct skills the set holds.
tools.SkillTotals.TrainingSeconds: TrainingSeconds is the time to train all of them from zero, rounded once.
tools.SovereigntyList.NamesUnavailable: NamesUnavailable is true when ESI could not name some alliance or corporation; the text shows "?" there and the ids stay in the rows.
tools.SovereigntyList.Systems: Systems holds one row per resolved system, in request order, duplicates collapsed.
tools.SovereigntyList.Unresolved: Unresolved lists requested names that are not solar systems.
tools.SystemActivity.Jumps: Jumps is the number of ship jumps through the system's gates in the last hour.
tools.SystemActivity.NPCKills: NPCKills is the number of NPCs killed in the last hour.
tools.SystemActivity.PodKills: PodKills is the number of pods killed in the last hour.
tools.SystemActivity.ShipKills: ShipKills is the number of ships killed in the last hour.
tools.SystemActivity.System: System is the system name as the SDE spells it.
tools.SystemActivity.SystemID: SystemID is the solar system ID.
tools.SystemInfo.Belts: Belts is the number of asteroid belts.
tools.SystemInfo.Class: Class is the text's band: "highsec", "lowsec" or "nullsec".
tools.SystemInfo.Faction: Faction is the faction the system, its constellation or its region belongs to; null for none.
tools.SystemInfo.Gates: Gates is the number of stargates.
tools.SystemInfo.ID: ID is the solar system ID.
tools.SystemInfo.IceBelt: IceBelt is the system's entry in EVE University's ice list; null when not listed (nullsec ice systems are not covered).
tools.SystemInfo.Moons: Moons is the number of moons.
tools.SystemInfo.NPCStations: NPCStations is the number of NPC stations.
tools.SystemInfo.Name: Name is the system name as the SDE spells it.
tools.SystemInfo.Neighbours: Neighbours lists the systems the stargates lead to, sorted by name.
tools.SystemInfo.Planets: Planets is the number of planets.
tools.SystemInfo.PlanetsByType: PlanetsByType counts planets per type name ("Gas", "Ice", ...).
tools.SystemInfo.Sec: Sec is the security exactly as the text prints it ("+0.9").
tools.SystemInfo.Security: Security is the true security status (the text prints it rounded).
tools.SystemInfo.StationServices: StationServices lists the services the system's NPC stations offer, sorted.
tools.SystemInfo.WormholeClass: WormholeClass is the wormhole class (1-6 C1-C6, 7 highsec, 8 lowsec, 9 nullsec, 12 Thera, 13 shattered frigate holes, 14-18 Drifter, 25 Pochven); null for none.
tools.SystemInfo.WormholeEffect: WormholeEffect is the system effect of a wormhole system (for example "Pulsar"); null for none.
tools.SystemInfoList.NotEnterable: NotEnterable lists requested systems that exist but lie in space players cannot enter (the Jove regions and the market pseudo-region); they have no profile.
tools.SystemInfoList.Systems: Systems holds one row per resolved system, in request order, duplicates collapsed.
tools.SystemInfoList.Unresolved: Unresolved lists requested names that are not solar systems.
tools.SystemList.JumpRange: JumpRange echoes the jump_range filter; null without it.
tools.SystemList.Offset: Offset is the number of matches skipped.
tools.SystemList.Origin: Origin is the system the jumps or the jump range are counted from (near.origin or jump_range.origin); "" without either.
tools.SystemList.Shown: Shown is the number of rows in Systems.
tools.SystemList.Sort: Sort is the order used: "jumps", "security" (most secure first), "name" or "ly".
tools.SystemList.Systems: Systems is the page, in the order of the text lines.
tools.SystemList.Total: Total is the number of systems that match, before paging.
tools.SystemRow.Belts: Belts is the number of asteroid belts.
tools.SystemRow.Class: Class is the text's band: "highsec", "lowsec" or "nullsec".
tools.SystemRow.HighsecRoute: HighsecRoute is true when near.prefer_high_sec was set and the jump count follows a highsec-only route, false when it fell back to any space (and for an origin that is not itself highsec); null without prefer_high_sec.
tools.SystemRow.ID: ID is the solar system ID.
tools.SystemRow.IceTypes: IceTypes lists the ice types EVE University's list gives for the system; empty when the system is not listed.
tools.SystemRow.Jumps: Jumps is the gate-jump count from the origin; null without near.
tools.SystemRow.LY: LY is the distance in light-years from jump_range.origin, to 3 decimals; null without jump_range.
tools.SystemRow.NPCStations: NPCStations is the number of NPC stations.
tools.SystemRow.Name: Name is the system name as the SDE spells it.
tools.SystemRow.Sec: Sec is the security exactly as the text prints it ("+0.9").
tools.SystemRow.Security: Security is the true security status (the text prints it rounded).
tools.SystemSovereignty.Alliance: Alliance is the alliance name, null when there is no alliance or ESI gave no name.
tools.SystemSovereignty.AllianceID: AllianceID is the holding alliance, null unless Status is "alliance".
tools.SystemSovereignty.Corporation: Corporation is the corporation name, null when there is none or ESI gave no name.
tools.SystemSovereignty.CorporationID: CorporationID is the corporation that holds the claim for the alliance, null if none.
tools.SystemSovereignty.Faction: Faction is the NPC faction name from the SDE, null when there is none.
tools.SystemSovereignty.FactionID: FactionID is the NPC faction holding the system, null unless Status is "faction".
tools.SystemSovereignty.Status: Status is "alliance", "faction", "unclaimed", "wormhole" (no sovereignty in wormhole space) or "none" (ESI lists no entry for the system).
tools.SystemSovereignty.System: System is the system name as the SDE spells it.
tools.SystemSovereignty.SystemID: SystemID is the solar system ID.
tools.TheraConnection.ExpiresAt: ExpiresAt is when the wormhole is expected to collapse (RFC 3339, UTC).
tools.TheraConnection.Hub: Hub is the hub the wormhole leaves from: "Thera" or "Turnur".
tools.TheraConnection.HubSignature: HubSignature is the signature id in the hub system.
tools.TheraConnection.Jumps: Jumps is the gate distance from the near origin; null without near.
tools.TheraConnection.MaxShipSize: MaxShipSize is the largest ship class that fits through ("medium", "large", "xlarge", "capital").
tools.TheraConnection.Region: Region is the exit's region name.
tools.TheraConnection.RemainingHours: RemainingHours is the whole hours left, rounded down, computed from expires_at when the answer is served.
tools.TheraConnection.Sec: Sec is the security exactly as the text prints it ("+0.5"); null in wormhole space.
tools.TheraConnection.Security: Security is the exit's true security status; null in wormhole space.
tools.TheraConnection.Signature: Signature is the signature id in the exit system.
tools.TheraConnection.System: System is the exit system (as the SDE spells it for known space).
tools.TheraConnection.SystemClass: SystemClass is EvE-Scout's class of the exit: "hs", "ls", "ns" or a wormhole class such as "c2".
tools.TheraConnection.SystemID: SystemID is the exit system's solar system ID.
tools.TheraConnection.WormholeType: WormholeType is the wormhole type code (for example "V898").
tools.TheraConnections.AsOf: AsOf is the time of the EvE-Scout copy the answer is built from (RFC 3339, UTC).
tools.TheraConnections.Connections: Connections are the rows: nearest first with near, else Thera before Turnur, then by system name.
tools.TheraConnections.Hub: Hub is the hub filter the request used: "thera", "turnur" or "all".
tools.TheraConnections.LeftOut: LeftOut counts the exits that near left out because they have no gate route from the origin.
tools.TheraConnections.Origin: Origin is the system the jumps are counted from; empty without near.
tools.TheraConnections.Shown: Shown is the number of connections in Connections.
tools.TheraConnections.Total: Total is the number of connections that match, before the limit.
tools.TrainingAttributes.BestRemapPerSki: BestRemapPerSkill is true when no attributes were given: every skill is trained at primary 27 / secondary 21 (its best remap, no implants), which is 37.5 SP per minute.
tools.TrainingAttributes.Perception: Perception, Memory, Willpower, Intelligence and Charisma are the character's attributes (17 to 50); null when BestRemapPerSkill is true.
tools.TypeInfo.BasePrice: BasePrice is the SDE base price in ISK, not a market price; null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.TypeInfo.CapacityM3: CapacityM3 is the cargo or hold capacity in m³; null when the SDE does not know the type.
tools.TypeInfo.Description: Description is the whole description, tags and all; Text cuts it at 400 bytes.
tools.TypeInfo.MarketGroupPath: MarketGroupPath names the market groups from the root down, e.g. Ship Equipment, Hull & Armor, Damage Controls; [] when the type has no market group.
tools.TypeInfo.MetaGroup: MetaGroup is the item's meta group ("Tech II", "Faction"); null when the SDE has none for it (a mineral, say) or does not know the type. It is never guessed as "Tech I".
tools.TypeInfo.MetaLevel: MetaLevel is the SDE meta level (0 for Tech I); null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.TypeInfo.PackagedVolumeM3: PackagedVolumeM3 is the volume once the ship is packaged; null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.TypeInfo.PortionSize: PortionSize is how many units one reprocessing or production portion covers; null when the SDE does not know the type.
tools.TypeInfo.TechLevel: TechLevel is 1, 2 or 3; null when the SDE leaves it empty.
tools.TypeRef.Name: Name is the SDE's spelling of the name.
tools.TypeRef.TypeID: TypeID is the item's type id.
tools.UnknownName.Closest: Closest lists up to three items with similar names, best first; [] when none is close.
tools.UnknownName.Query: Query is the name as the request spelled it (trimmed).
tools.WeaponGroup.DefaultAmmo: DefaultAmmo is true when no charge was written on the EFT line and the engine's default was loaded.
tools.WeaponGroup.Label: Label is the weapon with its charge, e.g. "Rocket Launcher II [Scourge Rocket]".
tools.marketHistoryRequest.Public: Public is true for a public surface, which gets the neutral unknown-id text.
tools.priceSnapshot.AsOf: AsOf is ESI's Last-Modified for the copy (the fetch time when ESI sends none).
tools.priceSnapshot.Average: Average is average_price by type id. A type ESI lists without an average price, or with 0, is absent: it has no estimate.
tools.theraSnapshot.AsOf: AsOf is the time of the copy as the upstream states it (its Date header; the fetch time when it sends none).
tools.theraSnapshot.Connections: Connections are the signatures whose hub is Thera or Turnur and that have not expired.
